blocks.content: Open Profiles Drilldown to begin investigating an application’s resource usage.
Open **Profiles Drilldown** to start your resource usage investigation.
blocks.tooltip: Start with an overview of the applications you can investigate.

blocks.content: You are ready to choose the profiling data for your investigation.
Choose a period with profiles, find one service, and follow its resource usage from label breakdowns into code.
Open the time picker, choose a range containing profiles you know are available, and apply it; the right range depends on when your application collected data.
blocks.tooltip: Set the period you want to investigate to include known profiling data.

blocks.content: Choose a service name visible in the grid, enter it in **Search services**, and wait for its matching chart to remain; use a name from your own data.
blocks.tooltip: Enter a visible service name and confirm that its chart remains.

blocks.content: Select **Profile types** to focus on the resource measurements available for one service.
blocks.tooltip: Move from finding an application to exploring its resource measurements.

blocks.content: Open the service picker, search for the service you identified in **All services**, and select its matching option; the available names come from your data.
blocks.tooltip: Choose the application whose resource usage you want to understand.

blocks.content: Select **Labels** to reach the profile type picker and the breakdowns for your chosen service.
blocks.tooltip: Keep your chosen application in focus as you move into its resource breakdowns.

blocks.content: Open the profile type picker and choose an available resource metric; choices depend on your application and language. Note its units, then compare the label breakdowns to see how resource usage differs across label values.
blocks.tooltip: Choose a resource measurement, note its units, and compare the breakdowns across label values.

blocks.content: Select **Flame graph** to examine code-level resource use for the same service and profile type.
blocks.tooltip: Follow the selected resource measurement into the code that accounts for it.

blocks.content: Read the populated flame graph without changing the selection: confirm the service, profile type, and time range, then identify a wide frame and its resource units; wider frames account for more of the selected resource usage.
blocks.tooltip: Identify a wide frame and explain its width using the selected resource measurement and units.

blocks.content: You have followed the same service and profile type from Labels to a populated flame graph for the selected time range, where you can identify a wide frame and explain its resource units.
